servers.delayTestNote: Periodic delay testing is done by the scheduler (interval in settings). There is no per-server test endpoint in the API yet — the last measured value is shown.

routes.conditionsHint: All conditions are AND-ed. For src-device pick a LAN device with the “Devices” button.
routes.lanUnavailable: LAN device list unavailable (endpoint not wired or empty lease file)

wizard.title: First run
wizard.step1.title: Add a subscription
wizard.step1.text: Subscription URL from your panel (Remnawave-compatible). Servers enter the pool after the scheduler updates.
wizard.step2.title: Default policy
wizard.step2.text: What happens to traffic matched by no route. Changeable later in settings.
wizard.step3.title: First template
wizard.step3.text: Ready-made rule set. “Ads & trackers — block” is the safest start.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.doneText: WellBoard is configured. Everything else lives in the tabs.
wizard.hint: Simplified wizard: 3 steps, no client-side URL validation — the server validates and returns the error if anything is wrong.
apply.applyHint: Generate the profile, validate (mihomo -t), write and restart with a health check
